definitions.explanation: The number 5,000, formed as {五|ご} (five) × {千|せん} (1,000). No sound change occurs.

examples.japanese: {五千|ごせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五千|ごせん}⟦{歩|ほ}→〜歩：00108_ho⟧しか⟦{歩|ある}かなかった→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I only walked five thousand steps today.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五千|ごせん}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{千年|せんねん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: The temple isn't five thousand years old, but it apparently has over a thousand years of history.

notes:
Formed as ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧ × ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧. Among the thousands, only three combinations change sound — worth memorizing as a set.

SOUND CHANGES IN THE THOUSANDS:
- ⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧: 3,000 — せん voices to ぜん
- ⟦{八千|はっせん}→八千：30471_hassen⟧: 8,000 — はち shortens to はっ
- ⟦{一千|いっせん}→一千：30472_issen⟧: 1,000 — いち shortens to いっ
- {五千|ごせん}, ⟦{四千|よんせん}→四千：30474_yonsen⟧, ⟦{六千|ろくせん}→六千：30475_rokusen⟧, ⟦{七千|ななせん}→七千：30476_nanasen⟧, ⟦{九千|きゅうせん}→九千：30477_kyuusen⟧: regular

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {五千|ごせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧: five-thousand-yen note, which bears the portrait of {樋口|ひぐち}{一葉|いちよう}
- {五千|ごせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: five thousand people
- {五千|ごせん}⟦{歩|ほ}→〜歩：00108_ho⟧: five thousand steps
